data.content:
Belgium expected lineup:  Lammens, Castagne, Ngoy, Mechele, De Cuyper, Lavia, Tielemans, Lukebakio, De Bruyne, Doku, De Ketelaere

Italy expected lineup:  Donnarumma, Kayode, Scalvini, Bastoni, Calafiori, Frattesi, Tonali, Barella, S. Esposito, P. Esposito, Cambiaghi

## Azzurri to make an early start [...] Italy and France sit on ten points apiece, while Belgium are one point behind. Van Bommel will have been pleased by his side’s reaction to falling behind in Izmir. Kevin De Bruyne and Charles De Ketelaere scored within four minutes of each other to turn the game around.

Romeo Lavia returns from suspension for Sunday’s game, but keeper Thibaut Courtois remains absent. Romelu Lukaku will be assessed but should make it. [...] On the flip side, Belgium haven’t drawn any of their five group games. They must win here and have no use for a point. In our view, the draw comes into play as a bet for a couple of reasons. Firstly, van Bommel is without Courtois and Koni De Winter. Secondly, we still believe Italy will score first. If they do, Belgium’s task becomes more difficult.
